117660.name: Friends of Lubavitch of Bergen County
117660.note: IRS: Friends Of Lubavitch Of Bergen County (Teaneck), ruling March 1981, so it existed by then. Rabbi Mordechai Weiss's blog ('40 Years', Times of Israel, 29 June 2022): his 'very first day serving as a Shaliach of the Lubavitcher Rebbe with Friends of Lubavitch of Bergen county was July 1, 1982'; 'It was just me and Yisroel' (Yisroel Brod of Teaneck, who recruited him and raised the funds); the office was in 'the basement of Yisroel's house' and Weiss gave classes 'around our kitchen table in our apartment'; after many years Brod bought a Masonic Temple, which became 'Bergen County's first-ever Chabad House'. Rabbi Ephraim Simon directs it now. Its start year is not found.

earlier.where: Teaneck: the basement of Yisroel Brod's house (the office) and Rabbi Mordechai Weiss's apartment (classes), as of 1982; later a former Masonic Temple, Bergen County's first Chabad House (when not stated)

117968.name: Valley Chabad
117968.note: IRS: Valley Chabad Inc, ruling Feb 1997, so it existed by then. The Jewish Standard (4 June 2026): 'That's what it did in 2000 when it moved into the Pascack Valley'; the Jewish Standard (CrownHeights.info, 26 Oct 2006): 'After six years in a house on Overlook Road in Woodcliff Lake' (Rabbi Dov Drizin lived there). Where it was before 2000 is not stated. Pascack Press (4 Aug 2024): its former home at 100 Overlook Drive is 'now demolished', and the borough approved its move to 530 Chestnut Ridge Road, where a new building broke ground on 17 May 2026 (opening 2027).

earlier.where: Woodcliff Lake: a house at 100 Overlook Drive (Overlook Road), its home from its move into the Pascack Valley; since demolished
